scores.justification: numeric-consistency is a deterministic claim-vs-claim arithmetic check; owns no rubric dim.

findings.rationale: claim '1\\% of' asserts 1% but the window fraction '100 / 100' computes 100 / 100 = 100.0%, not 1%.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the claim '1\\% of' with the values named in its surrounding paragraphs — either correct the claimed number or the population it derives from, or suppress with <!-- anvil-lint-disable: numeric_consistency --> and document why the arithmetic is intentional.
